title: Kiritani Haruka — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka, Minori, you there?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi? Oh, Shizuku, you too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka.
Is Minori not with you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's teaching some of her juniors in the animal caretaker committee how to look after the rabbits.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Then, we can try inviting Minori again some other time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For now, if you're free, wanna have lunch with us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. I'd love to.
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like it's been a little while since we had lunch together like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you thought so too?
We were also just talking about that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We get to eat together in the green rooms and buses for shoots and stuff, but we usually end up talking about work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, it's nice to just sit, chat and have lunch together at school like this for a change.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why you went out of your way to invite me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. It's a little unfortunate that Minori couldn't join us today, though...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure she's doing her best to teach her juniors on the committee how to take care of the animals.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
She sounded really excited about getting to teach them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I can already see her getting all pumped.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You didn't end up joining one, right, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I was thinking about joining one that was shorthanded, but most already seemed to have enough people on board.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that's really thoughtful of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Most people in our class said they wanted to put work first, so we just ended up drawing straws.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, what's it like being back on the credit-based course?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's it like...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, things don't feel all that different...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And despite being in a new class, I already know at least half of the people in it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you just returned to being where you were before...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, but... Something nice did happen.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I went walked through the doorway into my new class after the opening ceremony, the other credit-based students surprised me by...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Welcome back, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Welcome back, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hi, I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Welcome back, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I don't think being credit-based had anything to do with that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's really nice of them.
I guess Minori's also in good hands.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. She's already become friends with some of them, and has even made plans to do lunch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Way to go, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, Airi, Shizuku, thank you both for looking out for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, we're in this together, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly. Please feel free to ask us for help if you ever think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I will.
